varOutputSuccess.title: Success
varOutputSuccess.description: Whether the OTP was generated and sent successfully.

varOutputMessage.title: Message
varOutputMessage.description: A user-facing message about the OTP send result.

varOutputOTPSessionId.title: OTP Session Id
varOutputOTPSessionId.description: The Id of the OTP Session record. This MUST be passed to the Verify OTP action as input.

varOutputAccountNotFound.title: Account Not Found
varOutputAccountNotFound.description: True if no account was found for the given phone number. When true, the agent should offer to open a new account for the prospect.
